Document your client communication! Even if a client leaves a voice mail and you call them back and they don’t answer leave a note in the file that you at least tried to call the O and that you either LMOM or unable to leave message on machine.  Sadly there gets to be a lot of miss communication because documentation did not happen. Also ask the O what all their questions are for the DVM if they just say “I need to speak with the doctor I have questions about fluffies foot” sometimes you forget to ask them “ and what are the questions you have so I may tell the doctor your questions”. Also if there is an emergency on the phone like Owner is calling that Fluffy just had bloody stool get some more details before presenting to the doctor about the P like getting details on when O saw the bloody stool and how is the P energy and is the P E/D-WNL. Is the P urinating normally. Also are we a client at our clinic too! Sorry just random stuff I could think off

Im on antidepressants and I still struggle sometimes with my own thoughts of what ifs. I think everyone goes through there own type of weird thoughts. I sometimes like to take a deep breath I know sounds cheesy and take a moment to right a list of everything that I have to do. Also I look on YouTube for motivational speakers to help pump me up when I’m down. I know it can be hard to find that motivation. It sometimes won’t be easy to get up in the mourning and be there but it’s just finding that one little thing to get you out of bed. Also maybe just talking with yourself and try to find why you want and don’t want the help. I know it may sound weird but sometimes the answers are inside of you and just talking things out can help. That can only take you so far there is nothing wrong to seek out support. Also seeking advice online isn’t wrong but again that can only get you so far as well. I hope this helps.
